tool_inputs.name: query_string
tool_inputs.description: A valid SQL command string (SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT) to run against the database.

tool_processing_logic: Establishes a safe context connection to the local database path (/db/course_data.db). It compiles and runs the raw SQL string against the active engine, safely handles concurrency locks, commits changes if necessary, and formats rows into a standard structured array.

tool_outputs.name: status
tool_outputs.description: Indicates execution status: success or error.

tool_outputs.name: data
tool_outputs.description: The raw row records returned from the database tables (e.g., column-value pairs from Lec01_responses or Lec02_responses).

tool_inputs.name: target_directory
tool_inputs.description: The directory name relative to the project root (e.g., assets, skills).

tool_processing_logic: Resolves the input parameter against the absolute path environment on the Mac Studio. It safely evaluates the tree path, strips out path-doubling anomalies, scans the directory table, and returns an inventory list of existing files.

tool_outputs.name: files
tool_outputs.description: A list of file names detected within that localized space (e.g., [course_outline.txt]).

tool_inputs.name: file_path
tool_inputs.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path pointing to a static text resource (e.g., assets/course_outline.txt).

tool_processing_logic: Opens an isolated file stream, reads the raw byte content of the specified text asset, decodes it cleanly using UTF-8 formatting, and yields the unredacted string data directly into the active memory pipeline.

tool_outputs.name: content
tool_outputs.description: The full text block inside the target file asset.

tool_inputs.name: source
tool_inputs.description: The starting semantic entity node (e.g., Arvind, Lec02).

tool_inputs.name: predicate
tool_inputs.description: The relational directed edge link (e.g., collaborates_with, utilizes_distribution).

tool_inputs.name: target
tool_inputs.description: The destination entity node (e.g., Prof_Voleti, Tweedie).

tool_processing_logic: Initializes a localized relational schema connection inside db/agent_memory.db. It checks if the target nodes exist, applies an INSERT OR REPLACE constraint to prevent structural duplicates, and maps a directional edge connection between the elements.

tool_outputs.name: status
tool_outputs.description: Confirms the relational linkage was successfully written to the semantic graph table.

tool_inputs.name: entity_name
tool_inputs.description: The key string of the node entity to search for (e.g., Lec02).

tool_processing_logic: Queries the agent_memory.db tables using a bidirectional join loop. It pulls all structural relationship paths where the target string acts as either a source node or a target node, compiling a complete contextual index map of the entity.

tool_outputs.name: connections
tool_outputs.description: A list of formatted relational edges (e.g., [-[utilizes_distribution]-> Tweedie]).

tool_inputs.name: to
tool_inputs.description: The target recipient email address (e.g., student_email).

tool_inputs.name: subject
tool_inputs.description: The subject header line string for the outbound email.

tool_inputs.name: text
tool_inputs.description: The plaintext body content containing the personalized message.

tool_processing_logic: Establishes a connection to the standard SMTP outbound transmission pipe via the AgentMail SMTP server configuration, validates address syntax, and dispatches the compiled plaintext payload envelope.

tool_outputs.name: status
tool_outputs.description: Execution status check confirming delivery state: success or error.

tool_processing_logic: Launches the dynamic lecture-wide macro to sync sheets to the database, run batch Qwen evaluations on open-ended student text questions, and compile/dispatch personalized quiz portfolios over email.
